extract_crop_pairs: extract cropped image pairs from a crop list file using multiprocessing to save to output directory
load_crop_file: load a crop list file and parse image pairs with their rectangular crop regions
prepare_jobs: prepare job data structures for cropping images with hierarchical directory paths for organization

load_image: load an image file and convert it to RGB color space with error handling
